claims.evidence: PD 1.4.1.14: 'precursor mass tolerance was 10 ppm ... fragment mass tolerance was 0.05 Da. Carbamidomethyl of C, TMT6plex on K and TMT6plex on any N-terminus were set to fixed modifications. Oxidation of M was set to variable'
'as outlined in the manual for the TMTsixplex Isobaric Label Reagent Set ... except that the TCEP reduction was done at RT'; alkylation reagent not named in any study source

limitations: TMT channel map: paper Methods and PRIDE protocol prose contradict the deposited sample sheet, Supplementary Data 1 and the PD ratio headers; the latter (consistent) map is annotated.
CTR-EAE: paper says N=5 at p.i. day 32; deposited sheets list 6 animals at 36 days; 6 animals pooled per sheet; sampling time not available.
Dissociation method / collision energy / MS2 analyzer omitted: fraction runs used CID+HCD back-to-back and the column is single-valued; optimisation runs' settings are only in file names.
The 10 optimisation runs are re-injections of the unfractionated mix with different MS methods, annotated as technical replicates 2-11.
No search settings file (.msf) deposited; modifications and tolerances from Methods.
RAW files not opened (no techsdrf verification).
